name: Sr. Clare SCS
title: Pillar of Catechesis & Family Apostolate
ministry: Catechesis, Family Ministry, Parish Animation & Prayer Leadership
biography: Sr. Clare was a beloved, devoted member of the Satyaseva Sisters who served the congregation with unwavering gentleness, joy, and deep pastoral commitment to families and children.
quote: Let love and humility guide every step of our mission.

name: Sr. Tresa Mary SCS
title: Contemplative Heart & Steadfast Educator
ministry: Eucharistic Adoration, Senior Sister Care & Pastoral Mentoring
biography: Sr. Tresa Mary served the congregation through her profound spirit of adoration, patience in teaching, and maternal solicitude for the poorest.
quote: Perpetual adoration is the heartbeat of our spiritual family.

name: Sr. James SCS
title: Minister of Sacraments & Humble Service
ministry: Care for Sick & Elderly, Sacristy Service & Family Prayer Circles
biography: With radiant warmth and selfless charity, Sr. James touched the hearts of the sick and elderly, bringing Christ's peace to every household she entered.
quote: To serve the little ones is to serve Christ Himself.

name: Sr. Justin SCS
title: Apostle of Quiet Prayer & Educational Mission
biography: Sr. Justin dedicated her life to the education of children and accompanied countless families through compassionate home visits and prayer.
quote: In silent trust, God works wonders in humble hearts.

name: Sr. Rosalia SCS
title: Devoted Missionary & Caregiver of Families
ministry: Slum Outreach, Crèche Ministry & Women's Empowerment
biography: Sr. Rosalia poured her energy into village outreach, rural welfare, and supporting women and children across the mission stations.
quote: Where there is love, there is God.

name: Sr. Annamma SCS
title: Early Mission Pioneer & Pastoral Servant
ministry: Founding Mission Outreach, Catechetical Instruction & Village Visits
biography: One of the steadfast early pillars who walked the rural trails in faith beside Mother Regina, planting seeds of hope and Christian solidarity among needy families.
quote: God's providence never fails those who put their trust in Him.

name: Rev. Mother Regina Woroniecka SCS
title: Foundress & Mother General
ministry: Foundress, Spiritual Directress, Formation & General Leadership
biography: Rev. Mother Regina Woroniecka, born in Poland and formed in the Ursuline missionary tradition, felt an irresistible calling to serve the poorest rural families of Southern India. In 1976, guided by Bishop Mathias Fernandes of Mysore, she established the Satyaseva Catechist Sisters of the Families in Mariyapura. Her life was a radiant beacon of sacrificial charity, contemplative prayer, and total obedience to God's providence.
quote: Service to Truth — Satyaseva — is to bring Christ into the quiet domestic hearth of every suffering and seeking family.
